limits: Substitute API models and reconstructed splits; per-model calibrated budgets; three timed turns; upstream 1.5x acceptance and private-test score feedback. Quality is not an untouched held-out generalization estimate. Completion is not a model ranking or an exact-paper replication.

validity_definition.speed: Calibration: code exits successfully, produces a submission file, and the upstream scorer accepts it and returns accuracy. Cell budget is the mean positive duration of valid samples after all eight planned calibration episodes are evaluated.
validity_definition.timed: At least one scorer-accepted candidate with recorded evaluation time <= 1.5 times the stated budget; later candidates are excluded while earlier eligible ones remain.
